title: NDPI-Forecasting: code, selected data and result tables
description: Compact research release accompanying A multidimensional comparison for long-horizon recursive vegetation index forecasting: error accumulation, phenological retention, and spatial-pattern preservation. Includes original analysis scripts with portable paths, processed point time series, point phenology estimates, principal result tables and 100-pixel examples from each regional case. Model checkpoints, complete regional grids and fitted intermediate curves are not included. The provided verification command checks included phenology statistics and spatial-summary means; it is not a full retraining package. Code is MIT licensed; project-authored data and documentation are CC BY 4.0 subject to third-party source terms.
